notes.title: Version 1.002
notes.notes:
"Don´t Touch The Zombies" for iOS and Android is now available and the desktop version is full compatible!
Now you can play against mobile players connected to the same LAN !
+ New item effects added.

Thanks for playing “Don’t Touch The Zombies”

notes.title: Version 1.001
notes.notes:
Survival mode has been added!
In this mode you accumulate time only playing as hunter, then the player who reach the time goal will be the winner.
So, the key to beat in this mode is trying to be hunter as long as you can.
Play this crazy mode with your friends and tell us what you think!

Thanks for playing “Don’t Touch The Zombies”
